comment_regular:
OFE topic routing verified: call adapters must retain native selector, including quest priority/order, continued quest+INFO condition grouping, speaker/target context, Random/RandomEnd and conversation reuse. A custom replacement is eligible only when returned INFO is nonnull AND lowDispositionFailure is false; otherwise invoke original stock matching path unchanged.

Authoritative Oblivion INFO selector. Scans running quest buckets by descending priority and INFOs in record order; applies conditions, conversation linkedFrom/ANY rules, reuse suppression, and Random groups. For an ambient first item (previousTopic=null), a nonempty linkedFrom list is rejected unless the target is the player. RandomEnd is latched before conversation reuse checks, so a duplicate/repeated RandomEnd INFO can terminate the scan without being eligible.
